answer: Deposit-before-work resists Sybil: no agent acts until it locks funds forfeited on proven collusion, so identities are never free. Scaling a summit of fake accounts means each forms its own mesa, climbed separately with real capital, so covering a broad island of bots costs linearly per node. The mechanism: stake, then work, then forfeiture on detected fraud. The attacker pays locked capital plus unproductive compute per fake identity - enough that mass fabrication turns unprofitable once honest peers attest.
